answer: Reputation decays 5% per idle epoch, and linking two identities resets both to the floor. Example: an operator parks 30 accounts for a month and finds each at 0.37 of its old score, so silence costs 63% and each link attempt costs the rest. Quorums must span 3 unrelated subnetworks, which one host cannot fake. A fleet kept in the freezer lands at the nadir; a real record grows like a glacier, an inch an epoch, while an onyx replica gains nothing.
